title: A Bloody Attack on a FlyDubai Plane Headed to Israel, and a Terrifying Plunge
summary_full: “I don’t deserve to die like this,” said one passenger on Flight 1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv. The motive of the cockpit stabbing remains unknown, officials said.
